one_liner: When Aaron Judge connected in 2025, his batted balls graded to a .451 estimated wOBA on contact -- the best contact quality in this twelve-hitter marquee set.
three_things: Top-end power that stands alone here: 90th-percentile exit velocity 109.5 mph, the hardest in this group.
Loud on average too -- 87.6 mph mean exit velocity across 698 batted balls.
Pitchers refused to feed him heat: four-seam fastballs were just 24.5% of the 2,715 pitches he saw, the lowest fastball share in this set.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). The contact numbers (exit velocity, estimated wOBA on contact) are over the 698 batted balls only, not all 2,715 pitches, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model -- it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate or barrel profile. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction. 'Best/lowest in this set' is scoped to these twelve hitters.
